main.description: A CONTENT-FREE keeping heartbeat (G6): attests the ACT of reaching out, never its content. There is no message, observation, note, or assessment field — by construction, not by policy. Private content lives only in com.etzhayyim.encrypted.* envelopes (member-held keys, ADR-2605181100). Feeds the keeper-side social-capital mint (moyai-family, ADR-2606082100 Part A) — never any record about the kept.
